effect_description_eng: [Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 [Hybrid] trait card from your hand or trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card or under any of your Tamers with inherited effects, that Digimon or Tamer may digivolve into a [Hybrid] trait card in the hand with the cost reduced by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 Tamer card with inherited effects from your hand without paying the cost.
